channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Horace Grant | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Horace Grant from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jerami Grant on Horace Grant
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Jerami Grant on his uncle Horace (former Chicago Bull) and his opinion of him coming to Detroit:

“He's happy for me; I'm sure we'll see him at a few games.”

Jerami Grant on Horace Grant, Dec 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Scottie Pippen, Horace Grant
item.description:
“I don't think that statement needs to be corrected because I said it in jest on a bus with Horace Grant and Scottie Pippen,”

Michael Jordan on Scottie Pippen, Horace Grant, May 4, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Luke Walton on Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, Horace Grant
item.description:
“(Sunday) night, you see that look in (Jordan’s) face and you hear him tell Horace Grant: ‘Don’t let them see you, don’t let them see you whine, don’t let them see that you’re in pain.’ I mean, playing with Kobe Bryant, those were (his) words.”

Luke Walton on Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, Horace Grant, Apr 28, 2020. Source: The Athletic.
